source: docs/Diff between complete and NOLHC parameters.xlsx, sheet 'Complete Parameters' (same content as experimenting_ml/UI/'Scenario Mapping product category ALStudents.xlsx', sheet 'Input Parameters & Sources')
note: AS-IS values are the AnyLogic model's current/baseline setting for each parameter. This is the full parameter list (160 rows) -- it is NOT yet partitioned into the 35 NOLHC-varying vs ~122 fixed subsets; see spec.md section 5, DES access / dimensionality rows for the open confirmation needed before this partition is treated as authoritative.
known_data_quality_issue: NumTractorR / NumSecurityOfficerR descriptions appear swapped relative to the Dublin-side NumTractorD / NumSecurityOfficerD pattern -- flagged for mentor confirmation, not silently corrected here.
